name: ditto-claude-plugins
description: Ditto's official Claude Code plugins — give Claude a persistent, personal memory graph with zero-OAuth agent-native login.

plugins.name: ditto
plugins.description: Turns Claude Code into Ditto: automatic memory recall on every prompt and write-back of salient turns, backed by your Ditto memory graph. Agent-native login via @heyditto/cli means setup is one command and never gets de-authorized like MCP OAuth.
